name: arista-device-health
description: Arista EOS device health check and triage procedure. Use when troubleshooting Arista 7000, 7500, or 720X series switches — assessing CPU, memory, interfaces, environment, and agent/daemon health. Covers MLAG state validation and VXLAN/EVPN health as data center extension steps. EOS is Linux-native — standard Linux diagnostics (bash top, df, dmesg) are valid troubleshooting tools alongside EOS show commands. Includes agent health monitoring via show agent for EOS-specific daemon failure detection.
